---
title: "Browser session-surface guard"
description: "The shrink-only check that stops new browser access to session tokens while the shared session moves to a server-held HttpOnly cookie."
---

The shared session is moving to a server-held `HttpOnly` cookie that page
script cannot read (shared-session decision (b); see
[Authentication](/platform/architecture/authentication)).
Until every browser-side use is migrated, `scripts/check-browser-session-surface.js`
keeps the existing surfaces from growing. It runs in `bun check:changed`
whenever app or package source changes, and in `bun check`/`bun validate`.

## Rules

The guard scans `apps/*/src` and `packages/*/src`. It skips tests, stories and
the paused `backend` and `tanstack-web` runtimes.

| Rule | Matches | Baseline |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `browserSupabaseClientImports` | Static or dynamic imports of `@tuturuuu/supabase/next/client` or `@tuturuuu/supabase/next/auth-browser` | 88 files, to migrate in the BFF and data-access work |
| `postgresChangesSubscriptions` | A `'postgres_changes'` string literal (a realtime subscription that needs a JS-held session) | 0 |
| `sessionCookieScriptAccess` | `document.cookie` on the same line as `sb-`, `auth-token` or `app_session` | 0 |
| `sessionTokenResponses` | A `refresh_token:`/`refreshToken:` object key in a file that builds JSON responses or `{ body: … }` route results | 35 files, each with a reason |

The allowlist is `scripts/browser-session-surface-allowlist.json`, and it only
shrinks:

- A new match fails. Fix it by calling a same-origin API through
  `@tuturuuu/internal-api`, never by adding a browser client.
- A token response that must exist (native, CLI or provider OAuth) needs an
  allowlist entry with a `reason` and a security review.
- An entry that no longer matches also fails until it is removed, so migrated
  files drop out of the list.

## Short-lived capabilities inventory

Script may hold a capability only when it is scoped to one topic or object,
lasts at most 5 minutes (15 minutes for private download links) and cannot be
exchanged for a session. Inventory as of 26 Oct 2026:

| Capability | Where | Lifetime | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Realtime channel join ticket | `apps/web/src/app/api/v1/realtime/channels/route.ts` | 60 s, one topic | Within bounds |
| Meet collaboration-room ticket | `apps/meet-realtime/src/collaboration-room-do.ts` | 30 s | Within bounds |
| Cross-app handoff token | `generate_cross_app_token` | 60 s (300 s for CLI) once the bounds migration ships | Bounded |
| Chat file and time-tracking image signed URLs | `ai/chat/file-urls`, `ai/chat/signed-read-url`, `time-tracking/requests/[id]/image-urls` | 3600 s | Clamp to at most 15 min |
| AI image and QR tool outputs | `packages/ai/src/tools/executors/{image,qr}.ts` | 30 days | Clamp, or serve through an authorized route |
| User avatar signed URL | `packages/users-core/src/routes/users/avatar.ts` | 1 year | Clamp, or serve public avatars through an authorized route |
| Task update attachment signed URL | `apps/tasks/.../updates/[updateId]/attachments/route.ts` | 1 year | Clamp |

The Meet `*-check.ts` tickets (600–1800 s) are integration-check fixtures, not
browser capabilities. The clamps are scheduled with the storage helper
migration in the shared-session plan.
